padding.pitch_slots: -1 is padding; valid MIDI pitch values are 0 through 127.
padding.duration_slots: -1 is padding; valid duration steps are at least 1.
padding.delta_slots: No delta padding is used; each onset group has one delta value.

timestep_layout.delta_steps: Distance from time zero for the first onset, then positive distance from the previous unique onset.
timestep_layout.slot_alignment: pitch_slots[i] and duration_slots[i] describe the same retained note.

overflow_retention_rule: For groups over eight, retain lowest and highest pitches, plus six evenly spaced sorted interior pitches; durations remain paired with selected pitches.

v4a_comparison.interpretation: Raw note/onset/pitch measurements match V4A; retained slot values differ only for measured overflow groups.
